policy: Pending entries are release blockers. Public files record only role names and opaque evidence references; they must not contain signatures, private email addresses, credentials, or legal documents.

approvals.subject: Approved Chinese and English company or team name, public project attribution, copyright holder, and copyright years
approvals.evidence_required: Approved public wording and an opaque internal approval reference covering the repository and WAIC release

approvals.subject: Exact-hash authorization for every bundled image and logo across repository, documentation, social-preview, WAIC, and press scopes
approvals.owner_role: Technical owner, Brand owner, and Legal/OSS owner
approvals.evidence_required: Per-asset approval bound to the SHA-256 and each intended public surface; MVTec-derived images also need dataset-rights confirmation

approvals.subject: Disposition and reviewer sign-off for copied, ported, vendored, closely derived code, referenced weights, and bundled third-party content
approvals.evidence_required: One approved disposition per provenance entry, including removal or clean-room replacement where redistribution terms are incompatible or absent

approvals.subject: Non-public vulnerability-reporting channel and accountable security owner
approvals.evidence_required: Approved public reporting instructions and a successful private receive-and-escalation test
